sections: 8.11.4 configuration, intent, usage and application behavior
facts: OCGs have indirect identities; OCMD combines states with AllOn/AnyOn/AllOff/AnyOff or a PDF 1.6 visibility expression.
An empty/null/deleted OCMD group list has no visibility effect.
The default configuration BaseState is ON; alternate configurations can use OFF or Unchanged.
Groups not matching the configuration intents do not affect visibility.
Hidden content still changes persistent graphics state and text position; encapsulated XObjects can be omitted entirely.
An omitted usage-application OCGs array affects no groups. Multiple matching applications combine recommendations.
Viewer viewing adjustments precede temporary viewer print/export adjustments; stand-alone printing/aggregation uses configured states without those applications.
limitations: Primary facts do not qualify the implementation, renderer integration or full layer fidelity.
